title: 536–542 AD darkness and cooling linked to volcanism or comet debris

tellings.quote: Uh the years 536 to 542 AD were periods where, you know, the the the the the records of the monks and the the people who were living through that time talk about weeks and months at a time when they couldn't see the sun.

plain: From 536 to 542 AD, people in Europe are said to have gone weeks and months at a time without seeing the sun, a dark, cold spell blamed on volcanoes or on dust from a comet. Randall Carlson, a researcher of ancient disasters, tells it from the records of monks who lived through it, and links it to the ideas of the astronomer Fred Hoyle. He tells it to show that the sky has struck human history hard before.
